blocks.text: Chilliwack Poultry Farms for Sale — Quota, Barns & Buyer Guide

parts.t: Answers on quota, barn inspections, ALR zoning, groundwater licensing, and pricing across Chilliwack, Greendale, Yarrow, and Rosedale.
Are Chilliwack poultry farms less expensive than Abbotsford?

Often yes on a land-per-acre basis, though the total price still depends on how much quota is included, the age and condition of the barns, and the residence on the property. Compare across the region on our
What types of poultry farms are in Chilliwack?

Chilliwack has commercial broiler farms (meat birds regulated by the BC Chicken Marketing Board), table-egg layer farms (BC Egg Marketing Board), hatching-egg breeder operations, and turkey farms, located primarily in
Is production quota included when buying a Chilliwack poultry farm?

Sometimes quota is included in the asking price as a complete operating farm package, and other times the land and barns are priced separately with quota purchased or transferred per unit through the applicable BC marketing board. Each listing specifies whether quota is included or excluded.
Can I move BC chicken or egg quota to a different farm in Chilliwack?

Production quota transfers and relocations are governed by the relevant provincial marketing board (such as the BC Chicken Marketing Board or BC Egg Marketing Board) and require board approval, certified barn square-footage audits, and biosecurity compliance before transfer.
What barn systems and environmental checks matter most on a Chilliwack poultry farm?

Buyers and agricultural lenders inspect barn construction age, ventilation and computer controller systems, feed lines, backup diesel generators, mortalities/composting facilities, manure storage compliance, three-phase power, and licensed groundwater wells (confirming BC Water Sustainability Act groundwater licensing).
How do ALR house-size and Floodplain rules affect Chilliwack poultry farms?

Virtually all Chilliwack poultry farms sit inside the Agricultural Land Reserve (ALR) and are subject to Agricultural Land Commission (ALC) residence floor-area rules, City of Chilliwack AG/AL agricultural zoning setbacks, and Fraser or Vedder River Flood Construction Levels.
How is a commercial poultry farm purchase financed and taxed in BC?

Commercial poultry acquisitions are typically financed through specialized agricultural lenders (Farm Credit Canada or major bank agriculture divisions) underwriting both the real estate and the production quota. Properly structured transfers of qualifying farm land, buildings, and quota with a GST-registered buyer require specific GST and Property Transfer Tax apportionment by your agricultural CPA and lawyer.

blocks.text: Quota Transfers, Barn Audits & Biosecurity Due Diligence
